(2S,5R,7S,10R,13S)-10,20-Bis(ac- etoxy)-2-benzoyloxy-1,7-dihydroxy-9-oxo-5,20-epoxytax-11-en- 13-yl (3S)-3-benzoylamino-3-phenyl-D-lactate. Паклитаксел C47H51NO14 = 853.9. CAS — 33069-62-4. ATC — L01CD01. ATC Vet — QL01CD01. NOTE. Paclitaxel was formerly referred to as taxol, but the use of this name is now limited, as Taxol is a trademark. Pharmacopoeias. In Eur. (see p.vii) and US. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Paclitaxel). Isolated from natural sources or pro- duced by fermentation or by a semisynthetic process. A white or almost white, crystalline powder. Practically insoluble in water; freely soluble in dichloromethane; soluble in methyl alcohol. Store in airtight containers. Protect from light. USP 31 (Paclitaxel). A white to off-white powder. Insoluble in water; soluble in alcohol. Store in airtight containers at a temper- ature between 20° and 25°. Protect from light. Incompatibility. The vehicle for paclitaxel injection, which contains alcohol and polyoxl castor oil, was found to leach the plasticiser diethylhexyl phthalate from some plastic giving sets.1,2 Consequently, licensed product information recommends the use of non-PVC containers and giving sets.
